owner_calls.question: The only stage sits on Spider-Man (1994)#47, but its first sentence (Morbius is Debra's ESU lab partner, she has a crush on him, he turns her down for Felicia) describes their Season 2 setup, when Morbius was still a human ESU student (#14 'The Insidious Six' to #19 'Morbius'). Should the connection start earlier with its own stage, leaving #47 for her part in finding and reviving him?
options: Keep the single stage on #47 as is
Add a first stage on Spider-Man (1994)#19 (lab partners, her crush, he picks Felicia) and keep #47 for the search and revival
owner_calls.evidence: Marvel Animated wiki: Debra 'developed a crush on Michael Morbius, though he showed interest in Felicia Hardy'. Morbius was a human ESU student in Season 2 (appears in 'The Insidious Six', 'Battle of the Insidious Six', 'Morbius'). The Morbius page says he 'hibernated until Debra Whitman and Herbert Landon revived him' in 'The Awakening' (#47). I could not find an episode-level source showing Debra on screen with him in Season 2, so this is not a proposed change.
